complete.text: A job well done, $r. The Revantusk thank you for your contribution.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Silvermane Stalkers and 15 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.$B$BKill every savage owlbeast you see, $r. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.$B$BFor now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.$B$BSlay one and return to me with its plume.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

progress.text: The Razorbeak Skylord is a much rarer breed of gryphon: One responsible for mating and creating murderous offspring.

accept.text: Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.$B$BI want those tools back, $n - they mean the world to me.$B$BMarkhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.$B$BThose temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.$B$BRecover my tools!

objectives.text: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.$B$BYou recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

progress.text: Watch out for the Vilebranch trolls of the region, $N. They are ruthless, murderous filth.

accept.text: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.

complete.text:
<Lard takes the huge haunch of meat from you and stuffs it in his face.>

Dis hit da spot! Tanks little one.

Lard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.

objectives.text: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.$B$BLard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

progress.text:
<Lard rubs his enormous belly.>

Lard so hungry.

accept.text: The Wildhammer be striking up deals with our enemies, forgin' new alliances. This time, they be workin' with the high elves, mon.$B$B<Otho spits.>$B$BWe be needin' to send those Wildhammer dwarves a message - a message in the blood of our enemies. Slaughter every Highvale high elf that you come across, leave their bodies as a warnin'.$B$BNever mess with trolls!

complete.text: It be lookin' like the Revantusk are forgin' new alliances as well, mon! You done good.

objectives.text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.$B$BYou can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

complete.text: Oh, mon, this gonna be good. One more step to go and Wildhammer see that they can't mess with troll!

progress.text: The last message gonna scare them off for sure. Either that or make them very, very angry.

accept.text: Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, $n. That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.$B$BThe Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.$B$BIf Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.$B$BIt is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!

objectives.text: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.$B$BYayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: My mate was taken by Vilebranch savages in a bold midnight raid on our village. Our spies have told me that he is still alive and being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor. The Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing him for a sacrifice to the faceless blood God, Hakkar.$B$BYou must save him, $n! Our village could not stand a loss this great.

complete.text: You must act quickly, $N. Surely the guards have been alerted to your presence.

objectives.text: Primal Torntusk at Raventusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.$B$BYou have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

accept.text: The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, $c, for she is guarded well.$B$BKill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.

complete.text: Freedom at last! Thank you, $N. Revantusk will know your deeds!

objectives.text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torn'tusk when you have recovered the key.

progress.text: You must hurry!

accept.text: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.

complete.text: You have done the Revantusk a great service, $N! We owe you a great debt of gratitude.

objectives.text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

accept.text: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.$B$BSadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.$B$BIt is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, $n.

complete.text:
My dearest brother, how I will miss you...

Thank you for your assistance, $N. You are truly a hero in my eyes.

objectives.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

progress.text: When I have his remains, I shall take them to Yayo'jin and have them prepared for a proper burial.

accept.text: The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.$B$BThroughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.$B$BSteal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.

complete.text: The dark energy that compels the Vilebranch has been lifted - for now. We must remain ever vigilant in our battle against evil, as even if the Vile Priestess is destroyed, another soon takes her place.

objectives.text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

progress.text: Be cautious in battling the Vilebranch, $N. Their minds are clouded - they fight to the death.

accept.text: By order of Primal Torntusk, Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions are to be brought to justice!$B$BA grand reward is offered for any that slay the Vile Priestess Hexx and all of her Aman'zasi elite guard.

complete.text: A crippling blow to the Vilebranch, indeed. You shall be richly rewarded, $N.

objectives.text: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.$B$BVile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

accept.text: With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk:$B$BExterminate Vilebranch Berserkers.$B$BExterminate Vilebranch Shadow Hunters.$B$BExterminate Vilebranch Blood Drinkers.$B$BExterminate Vilebranch Soul Eaters.

complete.text: You are indeed a worthy candidate for the new position, $N. Accept these trinkets as a token of our appreciation for your hard work. I will be reviewing all applications next year.

objectives.text: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.$B$BShould you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

accept.text: Archmage Xylem has been asking around lately... for someone of your experience.$b$bIf you wish to seek him out, you can find him in Azshara.  His tower is built high atop the cliffs, and the only way up is a teleport spell invoked by his arrogant servant, Sanath Lim-yo.$b$bSanath makes camp below his master's tower.  To find him, travel to where Azshara's main road forks at the entrance to the Ruins of Eldarath.  From that spot, head directly north until you reach the cliffs.

objectives.text: Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.

accept.text: The blood elves in Azshara have developed a method for pulverizing the magical items they acquire.  This glittering dust they produce differs from the components normally acquired by a disenchantment spell.$b$bWhen I sent my apprentice to trade for the dust, he was killed without hesitation.  For that, they must pay.$b$bThe time for talk is over, $n.  Find the blood elves along the cliffs of Azshara and use more "persuasive" methods to acquire their glittering dust.

complete.text: Well done, $N!  It never ceases to amaze me how persuasive a volley of arcane missiles can be.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.

progress.text: Have you the dust?

accept.text: Take a look around you.  The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash.  Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to Azshara.$b$bSpecifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me.  Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research.  I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.

complete.text:
This is a superb specimen of coral, $N.  Your skills are unquestionably precise and deadly.

Do not think your efforts have gone unnoticed.  Perhaps you are worthy of a true test of your skill...

objectives.text: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.

progress.text: The spitelash sirens are surprisingly adept mages.  Not as adept as you, I hope?

accept.text: There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.$b$bYears ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole.  While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.$b$bYou must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple.  Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.

complete.text:
Now isn't this interesting? You say you found this tablet on a small, deserted island at The Overlook Cliffs in The Hinterlands, $c? Very interesting indeed. <Oran carefully puts the tablet away and rubs her hands together.>

I thank you for your efforts in this matter. Our Dark Lady shall be very pleased with this discovery. Here, allow me to reward you proportionately.

accept.text: You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully $c. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society.  Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style.  And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.$B$BSo here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?

objectives.text: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

progress.text: Do you have all 20 hats? I don't believe you, let me see them. They better be in pristine condition!

accept.text: Argh! They want the impossible from me!$B$BThe Steamwheedle Cartel wants me to teach the Southsea pirates a lesson.  The problem is that I can't be in two places at once; I need to stay here to keep the peace.$B$BOf late, the pirates have been disregarding the protection money that the cartel regularly forks over. So I'd like to temporarily deputize you to go down there and show them what for.$B$BYou'll find them at Lost Rigger Cove, which is not too far to the south.  Thanks $n, I'll owe you one!

complete.text:
$N! You are the man!!!

I'm sure that the Cartel will ease up on me now that you've dealt with those Southsea scum. Let's see, what can I give you as a reward? How about a little coin and you choose from one of these for your trouble?

objectives.text: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

complete.text: We suffer much from the events of the past.  Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw.  As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.

accept.text: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest.  Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.$B$BThe Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds.  Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped.  It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.$B$BPlease, $n - I ask you to do what must be done.  Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.

objectives.text: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans.  Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

accept.text: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.

complete.text:
You found it!  Oh happy day, this is!  Thank you, $N.  Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.

But my revenge isn't complete...

objectives.text: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

progress.text: Ahoy, $N!  Did you find Gorlash?  That chest was my favorite, and it has a hidden compartment that held my greatest treasures!

accept.text: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.

complete.text:
You recovered my sash?  Then...you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant!  Hooray!

I'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew.

Three times.

You are a $c of worth, $N.

objectives.text: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.

progress.text: Hello.  Do you have business with me?

accept.text: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another.  Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains.  I found them, but...they beat me.  They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.$B$BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.$B$BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!$B$BSpeak with Sprogger.  He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack.  He can help you find the giant.

complete.text: Hello hello, $N.  Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?

objectives.text: Speak with Sprogger.

accept.text: Negolash is a hungry giant.$B$BWhen the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen.  He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants.  Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings.  They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!$B$BIf you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings.  Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast.  When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!

complete.text:
You got my cutlass from Negolash!  I can't believe my fortune, $N!  Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!

Thank you!  And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.$B$BKill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.

progress.text: Did you get my cutlass, $N?

accept.text: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.

complete.text: Well now. This is certainly interesting...

objectives.text: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

progress.text: Got something for me, $c?

accept.text:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.

objectives.text: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

objectives.text: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

objectives.text: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."

complete.text: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.

objectives.text: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Have you brought something to add to our collection?

accept.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."

complete.text: Dwarven Engineering, always a marvel.

objectives.text: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.

accept.text:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."

complete.text: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.

objectives.text: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.

accept.text:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>

complete.text: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.

objectives.text: Whoever was here, you just missed them.

accept.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."

complete.text: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

objectives.text: Find what awaits you.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

complete.text: Your spellbook is ready, $N. May you fill its pages with arcane secrets to rival the ancient libraries of Elun'dris and Zuldazar.

progress.text: Those spellbook materials will take you on quite a journey!

accept.text:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.

accept.text:
The corruption that rains down from Hyjal flows through the mountain's waters and seeps into everything here in the wood. The creatures that drink the water take the corruption into themselves. It makes them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

To counter these effects, I must understand them, and to do that I need samples from the afflicted.

A few samples of putrescent organs from the wolves and bears should do. Take your time; the creatures are common here in Felwood.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Putrescent Bear Organs and $2oa Putrescent Wolf Organs to Kelek Skykeeper.

accept.text: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.

complete.text:
Our tools!

When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!

objectives.text: Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.

progress.text: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!

accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Bandarion Keep, brother.

objectives.text: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.

accept.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

complete.text: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.

accept.text:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $n. May the light be your guide.

complete.text:
Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.

objectives.text: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.

accept.text:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

objectives.text: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.

accept.text:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!

objectives.text: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.

accept.text:
Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!

objectives.text: Bring a Mana-Siphoning Wand to Izvi Gildfizz at Valormok.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

objectives.text: Speak to Nara Wildmane at Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text:
Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!

With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.

progress.text: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?

complete.text:
While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.

Thank you $N.
Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.

progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.

complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

objectives.text: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

complete.text: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?

objectives.text: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.

accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

complete.text: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

complete.text:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.

complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

objectives.text: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

objectives.text:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.

accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.

objectives.text: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

objectives.text: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.

accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!

accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.

complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

objectives.text: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?

accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

complete.text:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.

objectives.text: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.

accept.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.

objectives.text: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

objectives.text: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.

objectives.text: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

objectives.text: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.

accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

complete.text:
Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.

You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.

I look forward to further making your acquaintance.

objectives.text: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

complete.text:
So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.

Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?

objectives.text: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.

accept.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

complete.text: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

objectives.text: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.

complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.

objectives.text: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

complete.text:
Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?

There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

objectives.text: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

objectives.text: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

progress.text: So that's the story...

accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

complete.text:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.

accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

complete.text: Thank you, stranger.

objectives.text: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

complete.text:
Winds bless me, this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, $c.

objectives.text: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.

accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.

objectives.text: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

progress.text: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.

accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

complete.text: Thanks $c. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text:
These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village. 

With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.

accept.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.

objectives.text: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

complete.text:
<Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>

Storms curse--where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!

objectives.text: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.

accept.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

objectives.text: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

complete.text:
Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get. 

With these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.

objectives.text: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.

progress.text: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.

accept.text:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.

complete.text:
Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down?

I know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this.

I need to reflect on this for a moment.

objectives.text: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

accept.text:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

complete.text:
<Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>

Don't mind me, $N. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.

accept.text:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

complete.text:
Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead? 

<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.> 

The High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?

Pay this no mind, $N. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.

objectives.text: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, it's clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>

objectives.text: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?

objectives.text: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

progress.text: What news from the western watch?

accept.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

complete.text:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.

objectives.text: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.

accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.

objectives.text: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated $1oa Enchanted Skyhoppers.

accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

complete.text:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.

objectives.text: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: What beautiful things did you bring me?

complete.text:
Hey there! Nice to meet ya!

Did Kreza really say we're even? That's cute.

progress.text: A delivery on behalf of the horde, eh? You must be with Kreza.

accept.text:
Greetings, $n. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.

complete.text: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.

objectives.text: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Potion of Demonslaying, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

complete.text:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

objectives.text: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.

complete.text:
Any more complaints and they can bring them to me directly.

I am thankful for your work in retrieving this food, as are our warriors, despite what they say.
Swift work. Now let's continue our momentum elsewhere.

accept.text:
A moment if you will, $n. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

objectives.text: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Lady's Tear Moss.

progress.text: Have you found the Lady's Tear?

accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

complete.text: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

complete.text:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $c.

I will hold onto them for safekeeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of $c blood they have spilled this day.

accept.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

objectives.text: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

objectives.text: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal $1oa druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

objectives.text: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $n. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

complete.text:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the $c den.>

I--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows' sacrifice be in vain.

objectives.text: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

accept.text:
Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains.

The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike.

Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat.

complete.text: The scent of gnolls is not one that washes away easily.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.

complete.text: Heavier than I expected, but a wonderful addition no less.

objectives.text: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.

progress.text: Found my new trophy yet?

accept.text:
Our allies mining ore from the hills to the south reported several attacks by gnolls in the area.

Travel south, locate their camps and retrieve the stolen ore. Take it from their dead bodies if need be.

complete.text: You've done well, $N. The scorching heat from our flame will remove any markings or scent that remains.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.

progress.text: Have you located the stolen ore?

accept.text: Jom-jom came looking for friend. Now Jom-jom want to go home.

complete.text:
Jom-jom saved by little one, hmm?

Little one is friend.

objectives.text: Escort Jom-jom to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.

complete.text:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, $c. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.

objectives.text: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
You smashed weak Twilight ogres. But they weak.

Today you show Bloodmaster and little goblin friend you belong.

Tomorrow, maybe we meet again if you still breathing.

complete.text:
Hey, hey! Look what we got here. Another victim...er entrant lookin' to prove themselves at the precipice of power!

Well step right up, bub. Today's your lucky day... or not.

objectives.text: Report to Jezap at the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
