First things first. I'm gonna need a deposit for your, uh... safety.

Look, I don't make the rules here. It's required.

Now if you should choose not to pay I'll be forced to tell old Clugfist our new friend wasn't so keen on proving their strength to our warm, welcoming friends here.

That would be a real shame. Catch my drift, bub?

complete.text: A very wise choice.

objectives.text: Pay the safety deposit to qualify for the Bloodmaster's Ring.

progress.text: So, what'll it be?

accept.text:
The battle of the Bloodmaster's Ring begins!

We'll start you off easy here, pal. This flighty fiend'll take you down, then pick ya clean.

Now quit standin' around and step into the ring. Fame awaits!

complete.text: See? What'd I tell ya. Ain't nothin' to worry about here.

objectives.text: Defeat Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Humans are not our only adversary within the Riverglades, $n, nor are they our most dire.

A cult known as the Twilight's Hammer has begun a campaign against those they deem heretics in the eyes of their twisted gods. The ravaged remains of a human settlement to the west are but the first to fall to their conquest. No doubt Rog'mar will be next.

We cannot afford to let them establish a foothold so close to our doorstep. Go to this so-called Sunnyglade and thin their numbers.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N. With their numbers diminished, we can seek the source of the Twilight Hammer's unprecedented expansion.

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders and $2oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.

accept.text:
There have always been small pockets of Twilight's Hammer cultists here and there, but never have I seen them in such numbers. They seem emboldened by someone, or something, to expand their influence.

I would know more of these cultists and what they seek. Their shadowmancers are blessed by the dark powers and are likely the most trusted within their order to lead attacks of this scale.

Bring me anything you find off their corpses that we may glean knowledge into their campaign.

complete.text: These missives tell of disturbing news, $N. These are no mere stragglers aimlessly biting at our heels like rabid animals. The Twilight's Hammer is here for a reason. They are searching for something.

objectives.text: Retrieve $1oa Twilight Missives from Twilight Shadowmancers in Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.

progress.text: Slay the Twilight Shadowmancers and search their corpses. With luck, they will have the information we seek.

accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer are here for more than simple chaos, $n. They appear to be digging throughout the Riverglades for something. As for what they are searching for, I cannot say. A source of power, of course, but what that is still eludes me.

Their zealots may not be willing to divulge their secrets, but they must have someone doing the digging for them. These are the ones you are to question. Return to Sunnyglade and 'convince' one of their miners to talk. We must get to the bottom of this.

complete.text: Ouch! Ouch! No more hit! What you want?

objectives.text: Convince a Twilight's Hammer miner in Sunnyglade to divulge their secrets.

accept.text:
Alright, so you won a few battles. I think you might have what it takes to make it here after all.

Before I convince our next combatant to jump into the ring with you there's something I need from you first--food for Chub'chob's pet boar, Snufflesnout.

I promised I'd look after it, and, well, this gig here's keepin' me quite busy. Trust me, this'll benefit the both of us.

Mosey on over to the east of Clugfist's clubhouse. You're lookin' for a shy fella who goes by the name Gobam.

complete.text:
Goblin sent you? Me no like little goblin. He talk too much.

But me help Chub'chob. He good friend.

objectives.text: Locate Gobam in Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
Gobam know Chub'chob pet love to eat food. Specially good food!

Yum yum berry and plant from river make good treat for Snufflesnout. Berry sweet. Best berry from human farm near ocean.

You find. Bring back. Me help make big treat.

complete.text:
You make good work.

Berry smell yum yum good.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Sweetberry and $2oa Riverweed for Gobam.

progress.text: You get food?

accept.text:
Ok friend. Here is treat. Snufflesnout snort and be happy when she see this.

And tell goblin please stop talk so much.

complete.text:
He said that? About me? Eh, no matter.

It's time we focus on what's really important--keepin' ol' Snufflesnout happy, and by Snufflesnout, I mean Chub'chob.

objectives.text: Deliver the bundle of goods to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
Glad you made it through the first round, I guess.

This next contestant and I go way back. He ain't the brightest fella, but he's sure good at pummeling anything in his path.

Just head on into the pit and get yourself ready while I make the announcement.

complete.text: Hey, hey. Quiet down. I get the excitement, but that ain't no reason to rub it in.

objectives.text: Defeat Kronk in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
You did well slowing the Twilight's Hammer. Their foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened and you've turned their ogre warriors against them. Now we take the fight to them.

My brother, Dag'rosh, has already gone ahead with a scouting party. I would have preferred he waited for you, but he is impulsive and overeager--like a true warrior. I'd be honored if you joined him in battle at their stronghold to the west.

complete.text:
Krom'rosh sent you? He's more overbearing than a milk-toothed swineherd.

Not that I'll deny the extra muscle.

objectives.text: Find Da'grosh in the hills west of Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Do you see the fortress just west of here? The Twilight's Shroud, they call it. Filled to the brim with Twilight's Hammer cowards.

They may have walls and numbers, but their pitiful reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak. Show them how vulnerable they really are!

complete.text: Listen to them scream for their gods with no answer. The only true strength is within one's own hands!

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.

accept.text:
Those Twilight's Hammer dogs caught us before we could properly begin our attack. I was able to fight my way out, but my warriors were not so lucky. They were dragged off by the cult's champions and imprisoned in the fortress to the west.

Orcs do not belong in cages, $c. Free my brothers and sisters, and we will show these mongrels a real fight.

complete.text:
Good work, $c. 

My warriors are in no condition to fight and have returned to Rog'mar. But you and I are not done here yet.

objectives.text: Rescue $1oa Rog'mar Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.

accept.text:
Tran'gul's notes pointed to a leader of this Twilight's Hammer presence somewhere in that fortress. With my warriors free and the cult's numbers in disarray, now is the time to pierce the heart of this infestation.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and enter their Stronghold. That is where you will find Overlord Kilgar. That is where we will exact our revenge.

complete.text:
I would have loved to see the look on Kilgar's face when you showed him just how exposed he truly was.

And now I can.

<Da'grosh laughs as he tosses Kilgar's head into the dirt.>

objectives.text: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Da'grosh.

progress.text: The coward is sure to be hiding deep within his stronghold. Bring me his head that we may put an end to this blight.

accept.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.

accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.

objectives.text: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

progress.text: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $c, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.

accept.text:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.

complete.text:
Where did you say you found this? I'm surprised you're still fully intact. Thanks, kid.

Y'know. If you're in the habit of doin' favors, I bet plenty of folk 'round here will have a use for ya. Why don'tcha stick around for a bit?

objectives.text: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!

complete.text: Yes yes, very good! Now we get out of here and go to treasure.

objectives.text: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.

progress.text: Bring me fingers, *then* I show you treasure.

accept.text:
Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what?

You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget.

Hope you're ready for a surprise.

complete.text:
You sure ain't makin' me look good, pal. But I guess that doesn't matter much since our ogre friends here seem to be well entertained.

Don't let it go to your head.

objectives.text: Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Come, skyborne. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.

complete.text: <It seems Fuzzle had amassed a hefty sum of gold, at least by gnoll standards. Looks like it's yours now.>

objectives.text: <Fuzzle snarls.>

accept.text:
Let's see if we can keep this crowd's excitement goin'.

This next contender ain't no joke.

Best of luck to ya! See you soon, maybe.

complete.text:
Alright, big shot. Where the heck did you say you was from again?

You're startin' to make me look bad here.

objectives.text: Defeat Mog'thar in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Alright, so I'll place the treat and then you enter the ring and prepare for what's comin'.

What? Why you lookin' at me like that? I said we're gonna feed her. What I may have forgotten to mention was that ol' Snufflesnout gets pretty riled up at the sight of her favorite treat.

You're in a bit of a sticky situation here, bub. Proving yourself to our ogre friends is of the utmost importance, but boy oh boy would I be nervous inflicting harm to Chubchob's precious companion.

Well, off ya go!

complete.text: If I was you I'd watch yer step around here. You may have made a bit of a mess by defeating Chub'chob's friend.

objectives.text: Defeat Snufflesnout in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.

complete.text:
Let this serve as our message.

Lok'tar!

objectives.text: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.

progress.text: Has the leader been located?

accept.text:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.

complete.text:
As I suspected, magic bindings and a shadow cipher. It will take time to unlock the secrets within.

Nevertheless, your work has been of great help, $N. I will begin my work at once.

objectives.text: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.

progress.text: Find anything of interest?

accept.text: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>

complete.text: A curious find, $N. If this is from the stronghold it must be important.

objectives.text: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.

accept.text:
The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key.

It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.

complete.text: The moulding should hold. Let's see what we can do.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bar to Kreza Darkthorn.

progress.text: Do you have the materials?

accept.text:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.

complete.text: A gift from our enemies, bestowed upon you.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.

progress.text: Vengeance is best born of blood.

accept.text:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.

objectives.text: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

accept.text:
Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now.

Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death.

It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub.

Best of luck to ya.

complete.text:
Tiny thing show power in arena. Bring cheers from ogres.

Victory brings new friend to clan. You fight and feast with ogres now.

objectives.text: Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.

complete.text: Nicely done, skyborne. Now, we go for the bigger fish.
Delectable cuts, my sous chef. One pot of seafood stew coming right up!

progress.text: The trick to murloc eyes is you gotta cook 'em real quick. That way, you can still taste the brine!

accept.text:
Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground.

They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.

complete.text:
I see you're not afraid to get your hands dirty. I like that.

Thanks to you, things are shaping up for us to put those scallywags down for good.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Eastsea Raiders and $2oa Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

accept.text:
As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we?

I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it.

The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.

complete.text:
<Whizzbuzz lets out a surprised whistle.>

Whew, these are huge! Can't wait to light these puppies up and send those pirates sky-high!

objectives.text: Steal $1oa Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

progress.text: Got that gunpowder yet?

accept.text:
Now it's time to go after the big man himself: Admiral Lamora. Obviously, I want him dead, but I need a little something extra from him too.

Seeing how all his plundering has been costing me a fortune, I figure it's only right that I recoup some losses.

Lamora's on one of the Eastsea's boats northeast of here. Find out which and where on it he's keeping his loot. Bring me whatever he's got. If it's locked up, he's likely got the key on him.

complete.text:
I'll be honest, I wasn't sure you'd survive a tangle with Lamora. Guess you're the real deal!

If you ever need a favor you can call on ol' Whizzbuzz. Heck, I might call on you for one too if I need it!

<Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz gives you a wink and a crooked grin.>

objectives.text: Slay Admiral Lamora, locate his stash of loot, and return it to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

progress.text: Killing Lamora is about getting even. Stealing back his loot is about breaking even.

accept.text:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.

complete.text: Not bad. This should be enough to keep the ogres happy and still have plenty left for Rog'mar.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.

progress.text:
Don't bother with the little ones. There's not enough meat on them yet to satisfy an ogre.

Hurry, $c. They're starting to look hungry.

accept.text:
As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away.

Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.

complete.text: That should be the last of them. I'll need to repair the gate, but a swift kick in the rear will convince those little piglets not to go running off again.

objectives.text: Return $1oa Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. 

I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator!

The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?

complete.text:
Look at you, still got all your fingers and both your eyebrows! Er...not that I ever doubted my handiwork, of course.

Think I'll pull up a chair and watch the fireworks show. Good goin' out there.

objectives.text: Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats.

progress.text:
You may be wondering: What's a little ol' wharfmaster know about homemade explosives?

Let's just say... I used to make a less honest living.

accept.text:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.

complete.text: These good rocks! Hamur make tiny creature tiny weapon.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: Not all rocks equal. Some good. Some gooder.

complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.

progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?

accept.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

objectives.text: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.

complete.text: Yanked this right off that thing, huh? Impressive! With a little butter, and a dash of my secret spice blend, we're in for one hell of a meal!

progress.text: What's the word, skyborne?

complete.text:
<Argo throws a hand over his mouth in reaction to the smell.>

Ugh...great work skipper. Now <hic> put those away before I get sick again...

progress.text: When we catch that thing...oh ho...no one'll be laughing at ol' Argo then!

accept.text:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!

complete.text:
What the...ya actually got it!? Ha ha ha! 

<Argo clumsily snatches the creature's head, and looks it in the eyes>

Whoowee <hic>, what a beaut! Think I'll put 'er right on the <hic> stern! Drinks are on me tonight, pal!

objectives.text: Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle.

progress.text: Is it...is that monster dead yet...?

accept.text:
The threat is greater than we thought. Rog'mar must be warned.

Do not stop for anyone on your path.

complete.text:
As a child, Da'grosh would seek to inspire myself and the other kin of our village that some day we would all become great warriors of the Horde, saving our people from imminent danger.

Now, it appears that opportunity has come.

objectives.text: Deliver the missive to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

accept.text:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

complete.text:
Looks like you learned your first lesson well, lackey. And I ain't even gonna charge ya for that nugget of wisdom! Am I a great boss or what?

Take some time to reflect on this epiphany then it's off to your next assignment.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.

progress.text: How's trainin' comin'? It's just slittin' a few throats. I got high hopes for ya, kid.

accept.text:
Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people.

Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.

complete.text:
A gift from Friz? She must know when she's beat, harharhar!

What is that ticking sound...?

objectives.text: Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore.

progress.text: Yer lucky I don't split ye stem to stern fer steppin' on me ship, landlubber! Give me one reason I shouldn't keelhaul yer right now!

accept.text:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.

complete.text:
Captain who? Well, whoever he is, it sounds like you two learned my next important lesson.

Don't ever double-cross me.

objectives.text: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.

complete.text:
It's not every day we get a visitor from Powderfuse Port. That's no small trek!

I'm guessin' if you came all the way out here on your own you ain't in much caravannin' needs, eh? Who sent you, then? Friz?

objectives.text: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy.

All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port.

Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out.

objectives.text: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

accept.text:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?

objectives.text: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>

complete.text:
Strange scroll, you say? Yeah, this looks like some top-grade magic. The GOOD stuff. Thanks for bringin' it here, friend. Take this as a reward for your time.

Now, let me just see about translating this mess and getting it transcribed into my records...

objectives.text: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.

complete.text: <The ogre lies dead, surrounded by a ring of dark runes. It appears to have been overwhelmed by the powers of the Twilight Hammer's ritual.>

objectives.text: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.

accept.text:
Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now.

Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime?

Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.

complete.text:
Well, well. Looks like that cave was not our only surprise.

You managed to convince one of the Twilight's Hammer ogres to defect? And he mentioned others of his kind? We must act on this immediately.

objectives.text: Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.

progress.text: So, the Twilight's Hammer found something in the earth? You were right to banish this evil, $N. If it interests those fanatics, it's not to be trusted.

accept.text:
Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key.

There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you.

complete.text:
You smash Chogg'Zac? Little thing shows power.

What you want with Clugfist?

objectives.text: Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north.

progress.text:
<The massive ogre belches in your face.>

What tiny creature bring Clugfist?

accept.text:
Here ogres value strength and blood.

Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer.

You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can.

complete.text: Tiny skyborne show strength. Ground shook with dead Twilight. Me feel from here!

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Twilight Maulers and $2oa Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon.

But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him!

That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion!

complete.text: Skullbasher belong to real ogre. Someday Clugfist pick new champion.

objectives.text: Collect Skullthumper from Klunk for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: What you want? Bring Skullbasher now!

accept.text:
Clubtoe friends... dead? Why?

This Chogg'Zac fault! Dey say they make ogres strong! They lie!!

No more smashing rocks! Tiny creature help Clubtoe smash Chogg'zac stupid heads instead!

complete.text:
Tiny skyborne kill Chogg'Zac?

<Clubtoe lets out a triumphant bellow that echoes through the caves.>

Clubtoe done smashing rock for tinies! Clubtoe done losing friends! Me Twilight no more!

objectives.text: Kill Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave and collect their heads for Clubtoe.

progress.text: No more kill friends! Chogg'Zac die today!

accept.text:
Little skyborne smash Twilight good. Maybe your Horde stronger than Clugfist think.

You free to stay in Bolder'ok. For now.

Tell other tinies we spill blood again soon.

complete.text:
An ogre uprising? And so soon after their own battle for freedom from the Twilight's Hammer? These warriors have nearly as bloody a history as our own. They will make for powerful allies if we can continue to gain their trust.

You've done well, $N. I suspect this is only the beginning of our dealings with the Bolder'ok clan.

objectives.text: Report to Krom'rosh in Rog'mar.

accept.text:

I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.

complete.text:
<Crag'rog readies his mace to attack before he takes a closer look at you.>

Wait... Crag'rog know you. You fight for Clugfist!

objectives.text: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.

accept.text:
When Crag'rog hear skyborne-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too.

With tiny $c here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.

complete.text:
We free many ogres. This good. We kill weak, coward ogres. That better.

Only one coward ogre left.

objectives.text: Recruit $1oa Ogre Miners.

When Clugfist leave Twilight, one ogre stand in way. Morg.

Morg massive ogre. Nearly as massive as Clugfist. But not massivest. He need tinies to protect him. Clugfist never got fair fight. Now WE no fight fair.

Find Morg. Bring many tinies with you. Kill him. Take mace back to Clugfist. Then Twilight know they challenge us no more!

complete.text:
Morg is dead! Tiny skyborne full of tricks. Clugfist like you.

Twilight's Hammer crumple beneath might of Bolder'ok. We free ogres!

objectives.text: Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: Crag'rog say you join him in fight. What you bring mighty Clugfist?

accept.text:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

complete.text:
Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade. 

I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.

objectives.text: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.

progress.text: How goes the hunt?

accept.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

complete.text: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.

objectives.text: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.

progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?

accept.text:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.

complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.

objectives.text: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.

progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>

accept.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.

objectives.text: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.

accept.text:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>

complete.text:
Tiny skyborne not turn purple! Hurray!

But... where friends?

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Empowered Brutes and $2oa Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.

accept.text:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.

complete.text: Clubtoe feel better already! You smash lots of shiny pictures? Were others mad?

objectives.text: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.

accept.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

complete.text: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.

objectives.text: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.

progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.

accept.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

objectives.text: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

accept.text:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.

complete.text: Excellent, this is exactly what I need. I have read this tablet before, but that was when I was a young troll. It's been many moons since then and my memory is not what it used to be.

objectives.text: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.

progress.text:
Have you found the tablet?

I hope the Bloodscalp didn't give you too much trouble. If they did, I hope you killed them for it.

accept.text:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.

complete.text:
<Kin'weelay listens intently as you describe what you have seen.>

You are sure you saw the naga coming and going from this cavern ruin? Though what could they be looking for?

Perhaps it is connected to I'lalai after all. If this is the case, this could be the discovery of the century, $N! The Lost City has been a place of myth and legend for as long as any troll can remember.

But now it is possible the myth could be reality. There is no time to waste; we must investigate.

objectives.text: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

accept.text:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.

complete.text:
Good work. You are quickly proving your worth to the Horde with your work here, $c.

Planting these tridents outside the gates of Grom'gol will send a message that the Horde is not to be trifled with.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

progress.text: The more reports I get about these well-armed naga, the more I want them gone. Have you taken care of the problem?

accept.text:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.

complete.text:
<Kin'weelay's hands shake as you hand him the rubbings.>

This is ancient Zandali but it is still legible, even to me. These four tablets speak of the ancient city, though I have never heard this account before.

Nor have I ever heard of the Loa of Tides. I thought all of the serpents depicted at the edges of the tablets were the loa Hethiss, but to my knowledge his avatar does not have a cobra hood or fins.

Could this then be a depiction of the Loa of Tides? It almost looks more like a sea serpent.

<Kin'weelay's hands shake as you hand him the rubbings.>

These- these are in ancient Zandali! I can't believe they are still legible. No doubt you have been able to read these tablets as well.

These four tablets speak of the ancient city, though I have never heard this account before.

Nor have I ever heard of the Loa of Tides, have you? I thought all of the serpents depicted at the edges of the tablets were of Hethiss, but to my knowledge his avatar does not have a cobra hood or fins.

Could this then be a depiction of the Loa of Tides? It almost looks more like a sea serpent.

objectives.text: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.

progress.text: $N! You have returned unharmed, and mostly in one piece it seems. Come sit, and tell me; have you ventured to the ruins of the Drowned City?

accept.text:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.

complete.text:
I see you have returned. I take it to mean you have slain their leader?

Good. One less thing for us to worry about here. You have done well, $c.

objectives.text: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.

complete.text:
Excellent! I'll let the Baron know right away.

As promised, here's your share of the reward.

progress.text: Heya! Have you had a chance to take care of those blasted pirates yet? I have a crew standing by to go plunder-- er, explore the $r ruins.

complete.text:
I can't thank you enough! I will be able to sleep better knowing there are fewer of those Saltseers around.

I know the Baron also appreciates your service. Here's your bounty.

accept.text:
If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there.

There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really.

If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!

complete.text: Terrific work, $c. Once my little mining venture turns a profit I promise I'll cut ya in!

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Cinderscale Whelps and $2oa Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam.

complete.text:
Ah no...
<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>

I should 'ave gone with 'em. 

Much of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.

Now that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.
You can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.

The scoutmaster is dead, is he? Almost a shame you had to kill him. He deserved a life of wandering the world blind after everything he has seen.

Good work, $N. The Riverglades have become that much safer to traverse for the Horde.

progress.text: Keep your voice down. The humans are always watching.

accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

objectives.text: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

progress.text: <The offering stone is ominously still.>

accept.text:

complete.text:

objectives.text: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

accept.text:

objectives.text: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

accept.text:

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

complete.text: Wowee! Now that'll turn some heads! Nice job diggin' this up. There's a place on the mining team for ya, if you're ever interested.

objectives.text: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.

progress.text: To be honest, I'm not sure if cubic draconia can just be yanked outta the ground with your hands. If you have trouble gettin' some, come back here and I'll lend you some dynamite.

complete.text: Impressive work, mon. Ya got de makin's of a real headhunter in ya. Just remember ol' Tan'jani when ya make it big, haha!

progress.text: Ya find dem crocolisks along de rivers. Just don't get too close to dem, now. Heheheh.

complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.

accept.text:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.

complete.text:
Dese very heavy! Now me smash good rocks with heavy rocks!

<Hamur crushes the rocks you collected into dust, leaving only the weightstones.>

Dese good for smashing. Here you go.

objectives.text: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: Smith tinies turn rocks into heavy rock. Genius. Maybe you buy from dem?

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. He is one of the wisest Darkspear and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy, I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.

objectives.text: Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

complete.text: Well met!

objectives.text: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
